statement_summary: Annual risk assessment (SP 800-30) and targeted risk analyses
PCI DSS scope and data-flow per channel confirmed yearly; every SAQ answer backed by evidence
Service provider list, agreements with breach notice, current AOCs, annual check
Sanctions for policy violations
Total price in every ticket price display; accurate fee names and privacy notice
Change control for checkout, payment, pricing, bot mitigation, and firewall settings
No scripts on checkout pages; approved script list for event pages; vendor change alerts
Unique named accounts; no shared box office or bar logins
Least privilege; at most 3 ticketing administrators
MFA for all ticketing users and all administrator and remote access
Password standard and no vendor default passwords
Same-day access removal; end dates on contractor accounts
Quarterly access reviews
Least-scope API keys in the key vault; annual rotation
On-demand, named, MFA vendor remote access
Separate or remove card data devices; keep production and CCTV segments separate
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Keep security logs 12 months; daily alerts and weekly review
Acquirer notice within 24 hours of suspected compromise; follow card brand instructions
Preserve evidence with chain of custody
Meet breach notification deadlines
Annual tabletop and role training
Never keep card numbers or security codes in any form
Shred any paper with card data at once and report it
Encrypt Restricted data; no patron exports as attachments or in public storage
Patron data used only for noticed purposes
Separate-account immutable backups restore-tested quarterly
Box office workstations and payment devices used only for sales
Annual training; phone-order card handling; quarterly phishing exercises
Card reader inspection before doors on each event day
Callback verification for payment detail changes
Approved AI tools only for company data
